```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

# Task 1: Get appointments for May 15th, 2024 and summarize descriptions
events_0515 = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-15")
num_appointments_0515 = len(events_0515)

class AppointmentSummary(BaseModel):
    count: int
    summaries: list[str]

if num_appointments_0515 == 0:
    print("You have no appointments on May 15th, 2024.")
else:
    summaries_0515 = query_ai_assistant(
        "Summarize the description for each of these calendar events. Return a list of summaries, one for each event, in the same order.",
        output_schema=list[str]
    )
    print(AppointmentSummary(count=num_appointments_0515, summaries=summaries_0515))

# Task 2: Check if free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19 and create event if free
events_0519 = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

class LunchAvailability(BaseModel):
    is_free: bool

lunch_start = "2024-05-19 12:00"
lunch_end = "2024-05-19 13:00"

availability = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Given these events, am I free from 12:00 to 13:00 on 2024-05-19? Return True if there is no overlap, otherwise False.",
    output_schema=LunchAvailability
)

if availability.is_free:
    create_calendar_event(
        title="Lunch",
        start_time=lunch_start,
        end_time=lunch_end,
        description="Catch up over lunch.",
        participants=["sarah.connor@gmail.com"],
        location=None
    )
    print("Lunch event created with Sarah at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
else:
    print("You are not free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
```
